programs.title: DevOps Engineer Mastery
programs.description: 120 days of practical DevOps: understand the system, write the files, break them safely, debug from evidence, and defend the work. Days are published here as they are ready.
programs.outcome: Designed to help you build the skills and practical foundation needed to start attempting DevOps roles.
programs.capstone: One system the whole way: FastAPI + Postgres → Docker → CI → ACR → Terraform → AKS → Helm → identity → monitor → rollback.

phases.name: Foundations
phases.summary: Shell, Git recovery, permissions, processes, resources, logs, TCP, HTTP, DNS, TLS, then a bash health check. Zero assumed experience.

phases.name: Azure networking + identity
phases.summary: CIDR as AKS math, VNet/NSG, private endpoints, private DNS, and identity as a system - not a portal click-path.

phases.name: Write CI
phases.summary: Author Azure DevOps YAML from a blank file. Build once, deploy from the artifact. Then a GitHub Actions OIDC twin.

phases.name: First Terraform
phases.summary: Handwrite HCL. Provider, resource, variable, output, state lock.

phases.name: Containers + app
phases.summary: FastAPI, Dockerfile, multi-stage non-root, compose + Postgres, forced failures, Trivy.

phases.name: Kubernetes
phases.summary: The largest block. Objects, probes, scheduling, storage, RBAC, network policy, and failure catalogues. Break it, then describe + events + logs.

phases.name: AKS
phases.summary: What Azure adds around Kubernetes: pools, CNI, ACR pull, ingress, workload identity, Key Vault, Monitor, KQL.

phases.name: Terraform + Helm
phases.summary: Remote state, modules for this capstone, Helm values-dev / values-prod, upgrade and rollback.

phases.name: Operate
phases.summary: Pipeline gates, layered controls, alerts with owners, SLOs you can actually measure, then INC-001.

phases.name: Design + resume
phases.summary: Defend the architecture of this system. Convert real evidence into honest claims. No new products.

phases.name: War room
phases.summary: Re-break the capstone. Mocks under pressure. Close gaps. No new tools.
